g.text: Exploratory plots reveal distribution and association before a model is selected

text.style: font-size: 9px; font-family: 'DejaVu Sans'; text-anchor: start; fill: #59636c

g.text: Six synthetic records with paired load/cycle observations. Association is not causal evidence; the last point illustrates why simple trends should be
examined rather than assumed. Histograms depend on bin definitions. Sample standard deviation uses n−1; no process-capability conclusion, fitted
regression, or calibrated load effect is assigned.
